acceptance_criteria: PATCH /vehicles/{id} with fuel_level field updates the record
Response returns updated fuel_level and last_fuel_update timestamp
If driver not assigned to vehicle, API returns 403

non_functional_requirements.authentication: required — JWT is used to protect all endpoints
non_functional_requirements.authorization: Managers can view and edit any vehicle; Drivers can only view and edit the vehicle assigned to them
non_functional_requirements.pagination: required on GET /vehicles and any filtered list endpoints
non_functional_requirements.search: vehicles can be searched by license_plate via query parameter q
non_functional_requirements.real_time: yes — GPS streaming via WebSocket for individual vehicles

data_entities_detail.name: User
data_entities_detail.description: Represents a system user, either a fleet manager or a driver
relationships: has many Vehicles as assigned driver

data_entities_detail.name: Vehicle
data_entities_detail.description: Stores static vehicle data and dynamic telemetry such as location, fuel, and performance metrics

out_of_scope: Geofencing and alerts for entering/exiting zones
